newsOverlay.marketBias: MIXED: falling oil and Treasury yields support risk assets, while multiple Fed officials continue to emphasize elevated inflation and possible further tightening. Contextual only; no independent buy signal.

items.headline: Fed's Collins backs September rate hike and warns inflation risks remain elevated
items.summary: Reuters reports Boston Fed President Susan Collins supported the latest rate increase and said a more restrictive federal funds rate is needed to return inflation sustainably to target. Her comments reinforce the Fed's hawkish bias after last week's hike.
items.whyItMatters: Further tightening can raise real yields and the dollar and reduce liquidity available to risk assets including crypto.
items.actionReason: Material hawkish macro context, but no verified CRITICAL direct asset threat.

items.headline: Oil falls below $100 as Iran signals possible Hormuz reopening and risk assets rally
items.summary: Reuters reports Brent around $97.6, lower Treasury yields and stronger global equities as Iran signaled the Strait of Hormuz could reopen within a week under conditions. The move eases immediate inflation pressure but remains contingent on diplomacy.
items.whyItMatters: Lower oil and yields improve immediate risk liquidity, but geopolitical and Fed risks remain unresolved.
items.actionReason: Positive macro transmission does not create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Oil extends sharp fall and Treasury yields retreat as global risk appetite improves
items.summary: Reuters reports U.S. crude down about 4.8% to $95.49 and Brent down about 3.56%, while Treasury yields retreated and U.S. equities rallied; Bitcoin was up about 6.3%.
items.whyItMatters: Lower oil and yields ease immediate inflation/liquidity pressure and support risk assets, but do not override Fed tightening risk.
items.actionReason: Positive macro transmission does not create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Fed's Goolsbee says strong demand may be adding to U.S. inflation
items.summary: Reuters reports Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said inflation may now be materially driven by strong demand in addition to supply shocks, which could require a stronger Fed response if confirmed.
items.whyItMatters: Demand-driven inflation can keep rates and the dollar restrictive for crypto liquidity.
items.actionReason: Material hawkish macro context, but no direct CRITICAL asset threat.

items.headline: Bitcoin approaches $85,000 as broad short squeeze accelerates crypto breakout
items.summary: CoinDesk reports BTC traded near $84,984, up 5.4% in 24 hours, while roughly $647.9 million of short positions were liquidated across crypto in 24 hours; open interest and volume also rose sharply.
items.whyItMatters: A liquidation-driven breakout with rising open interest can extend momentum but also increases reversal and chase risk.
items.actionReason: The move is extended and materially squeeze-driven; positive momentum does not create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Oil falls as Iran diplomacy hopes and Saudi exports improve supply outlook
items.summary: Reuters reported oil falling as hopes for U.S.-Iran diplomacy and a rebound in Saudi exports reduced the immediate supply-risk premium; the decline has since deepened materially.
items.whyItMatters: Lower oil reduces immediate inflation and rates pressure on global risk liquidity, but geopolitical risk remains unresolved.
items.actionReason: Material reversal of the earlier oil shock; no independent trade action.

items.headline: Oil rises after Houthi attack on Saudi capital
items.summary: Reuters reported Brent and WTI rose after Houthi attacks on Riyadh renewed supply-risk concerns; subsequent September 21 trading reversed that move materially.
items.whyItMatters: The earlier oil shock was a material inflation/liquidity risk but has since reversed lower.
items.actionReason: Major reversal recorded; no independent trade action.

items.headline: Fed's Kashkari says inflation remains too high beyond oil
items.summary: Reuters reports Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said inflation remains too high across the U.S. economy, including after excluding food and energy, and backed the Fed's recent quarter-point rate increase.
items.whyItMatters: Persistent core inflation and an additional-hike bias can keep U.S. yields and the dollar elevated, tightening global risk liquidity.
items.actionReason: Material hawkish macro context, but no direct CRITICAL asset threat.

items.headline: Houthi attacks on Riyadh deepen Saudi and energy-supply risk
items.summary: Reuters reports Saudi and Gulf equities fell after Houthi missile and drone attacks targeting Riyadh; the Houthis also claimed an attack on an Aramco facility at Yanbu.
items.whyItMatters: Escalation can increase oil-price, inflation, rates and global risk-liquidity volatility.
items.actionReason: Material geopolitical risk, but no verified CRITICAL direct asset threat.

catalysts.headline: Avalanche Helicon activation time has passed; network status remains operational while explicit activation confirmation is pending
catalysts.summary: Avalanche's official documentation scheduled Helicon for 15:00 UTC today. At 17:39 Madrid, Avalanche's official status page reports all systems operational, but the Builder Hub still labels Mainnet Helicon as scheduled, so successful activation is not yet claimed without explicit primary confirmation.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The critical pre-upgrade window has passed without a reported service outage, reducing immediate event risk, but explicit successful activation confirmation is still pending.
catalysts.actionReason: AVOID NEW ENTRY was tied to the <=2h pre-activation window and is no longer justified solely by the clock; no buy signal is created and post-upgrade confirmation remains pending.
